text:
mike: quick heads-up — predeploy eval for release v3.12.0 (routing) shows a small regression on summarizer prompt set, requesting triage. deploying in ~2h unless we soft-lock.

jen: what metrics? can you paste delta and sample ids?

mike: here are the quick numbers:
```
suite: summarizer_prompt_v2
baseline: v3.11.4
candidate: v3.12.0
metric: ROUGE-L
baseline_mean: 0.742
candidate_mean: 0.736
delta: -0.006 (-0.8%)
threshold: -0.5%
samples_failed: 12/150
```

deploybot: preflight-eval check: FAIL — regression -0.8% exceeds configured threshold -0.5%. Auto-canary-hold recommended. See /deploy 1745004321

anna: can we isolate by quant profile or tokenization? 12 failures, any regex in prompts?

mike: failures clustered on long-context docs and "TL;DR" style prompts. Suspect KV-cache off-path in new kernel. Will run a targeted repro.

qa-bot: suggestion: run rerun with seed=42 on failed sample ids [23,45,67,89,101,112,130,133,137,140,144,149] and compare logits/topk diffs.

lucas: from infra side, we can stage a canary on eu-west-1 only and route 5% traffic. That buys time but increases operational load.

product-mark: any user-visible regressions? length or hallucination? need to decide for release notes.

jen: propose soft-lock: block global rollout, allow eu-canary 5% for 6 hours while mike/anna triage. If reruns clear, we can lift. If not, pin v3.11.4 globally. @deploybot, set canary=eu-west-1 5% and block global rollout.

deploybot: acknowledged. Action: set canary(eu-west-1)=5% for release v3.12.0; global rollout paused. Ticket: RB-4589 created.

mike: will run reruns and log bisect steps, cc @anna @lucas. ETA 90m.

jen: thanks. I'll update release notes and notify stakeholders. :thumbsup:
